notes.title: 2.4 Patch
notes.content:
[b]Just some small things getting fixed:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed Rey's head being upside down at the start of a new run.
[*] Locked menus being accessible fixed.
[*] Overlapping Tooltips fixed
[*] Massive lag after end demo scene
[*] Hector double dialogue fixed
[*] Hector not speaking at all fixed.
[*] Area loading and overlapping fixed. (Floor matches color)
[*] Sword tooltip overstaying its welcome fixed.
[*] Game now closes on ending the demo.
[*] Menu pop-ups while at Hector fixed.
[*] Flashing menu’s after skipping dialogue is fixed.
[*] Running dust clouds hugging the player fixed.
[*] Second statue reward is now cheaper 750 --> 500.
[/list]

notes.title: Version 2.4
notes.content:
[b][i]Beginners now have a chance to play as well.[/i][/b]
I noticed that a lot of people had trouble with the game.
Dying over and over again made it so that players would quit.
On top of that, the game was not really holding any hands.
So it was very punishing for people who didn’t know what they were doing.

But now that should be fixed.
I added: 
[list]
[*] A simple beginner guide.
[*] Difficulty options
[*] Tooltips
[*] Cheatcodes
[/list]

[b]On top of that, lots of small fixes. Like wrappable menus and stuff.[/b]
Go check it out! Now everybody can enjoy the game.
